notes.title: Infos and development state
notes.content:
Hey quest giving interested people, 
thank you for being the first ones to follow us here on Steam. 

We thought it was time to give you a little insight in what's going on, and what will be going on in the near future.
First off, for everyone who hasn't been following us on other platforms previously: 
there will be a demo of this game. 
So in case you have found this and thought it was interesting, but didn't know what to make of it, don't worry. You will be able to test what it's like being a quest giver. We are pretty sure that everyone has different expectations on how this game actually plays out, and it will almost certainly not satisfy each and everyone's wishes (like no game does).
There won't be an Early Access version, but rather just this demo, which you can use to check out the game, which we can then use to gather your feedback and possibly make changes to the final version. 

[h1]When will the demo come out?[/h1]

We don't want to raise your hopes at this stage, so all we can say is that we're starting the internal testing phase next week, which will then result in some bug fixing and editing. Since we don't know how long this last step will take, we can't really tell you when the demo will come out. Sorry to everyone who's been waiting on this for a longer time now.
On the upside, we have new team members now and it's safe to say that our development speed has doubled.

[h1]Where can I get more infos on the game and its development?[/h1]

We are on a variety of platforms where you can read and see more of what we do and how the game works:

[url=https://www.instagram.com/thinkrestless/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/thinkrestless]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/have.a.quest/]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.brightlocker.com/games/the-quest-giver]Brightlocker[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB]Discord[/url]
[url=http://thinkrestless.com/the-quest-giver/]Homepage[/url]

If you have questions, want to share an opinion, or give us pre-demo feedback, please feel free to leave a comment, use the Community Hub, or talk to us directly on Discord.
We're excited to hear what brought you to our game, or what you expect of it.

Cheers!
Your rest.less Games team
